correctness.rationale: The 21 binary coefficients constrained to vanish at all seven F2-plane points form an explicit 14-dimensional kernel (16384 forms). Independent full finite enumeration found 2187 forms smooth at rational points, 18 PGL3(F2)-orbits; Groebner tests on each orbit representative across all three affine charts found exactly ten geometrically smooth orbits, totaling 1512 equations. For each of the ten masks the six-dimensional Cartier matrix H_{(i,j),(k,l)}=[x^(2k+1-i)y^(2l+1-j)]f in F2 gives a=6-rank(H) and f2=rank(H^6). Independent arithmetic gives joint multiplicities (2,3):168, (2,1):252, (5,1):336, (6,0):756, matching the claim. The separate actual point-count code recovers 2-rank from extension-field Hasse–Weil coefficients, not the a-number. Finite exhaustion proves this finite classification, not arbitrary fields/degrees.
